liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): The Dark Star performance is described as very good for that era; Dark Star features a big Phil solo resolving into a sweet Morning Dew [9][19]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain, Loser, and the Weather Report Suite jam are praised [10]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider is noted as excellent [11]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider features a laid-back jam [18]
- **Playing In/The Band** (1 review): Playing In The Band is really jamming and goes to interesting places [19]
- **Weather Report Suite** (1 review): Listener calls the Weather Report Suite the highlight of the show [9]
- **Weather Report Suite Prelude** (1 review): The Weather Report Suite Prelude into Part 1 and Let It Grow is best [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-09-11.120143.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 194 min; rated 4.9/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: SBD source had numerous pops in the left and right channels [1]
- **gd73-09-11.sbd.lanum.184.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 178 min; rated 4.37/5 by 52 [4]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is nice, with lossless format recommended over low fidelity; The sound quality is described as pure crisp excellence; Listener cannot hear horns until Let It Grow, despite SBD claims [10][11][16][17]
- **gd1973-09-11.152009.sbd.gems.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 179 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [6]
- **gd1973-09-11.116231.aud.warburton.berger.cousinit-patched.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 196 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [2]

## Around the show

- A band member celebrated their birthday, contributing to a good night [10]
- Martin Fierro plays energetic horn solos without overstaying his welcome [11]
- Phil Lesh performs a rare solo featuring horns and exploration [12]
- Doug Sahm's band opened, and their sax player played on Weather Report [13]
- Bobby announced the band would return the next night at 2:00 am [13]
- Uncle John's Band riff appears in the middle of I Know You Rider [18]
- The concert was played for Mickey Hart's birthday [20]
- Listener compares this show favorably to the March 28, 1973 concert [12]
- This is the first of eight shows featuring horns [16]
- Show holds its own against heavy competition in 1973 [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-09-11.120143.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by matrix by dusborne; source: 2 source matrix: SBD: MR>C1>DAT>Goodbear_Edit>CD (shnid=113051) and Original Audience Source: (shnid=116231) Jimmy Warburton's reel [1]. Also: Martin Fierro and Joe Ellis played horns on various songs [1]
- **gd73-09-11.sbd.lanum.184.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd1973-09-11.152009.sbd.gems.flac16**: transferred by Mastering by Jamie Waddell and Jim Blackwood Speed corrections by Jason Chastain Listening assistance and track, FLAC and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Master Soundboard Reels to DAT 16 bit 44.1kHz from ANON Also, a Kind LL member shared uncirculated lo-fi audience tapes to patch a few spots [6]. Also: Best of radio program aired on 91.3 FM KXCI Tucson in 2021; FLAC Level 8 file originally shared at shnflac.net on March 7, 2021 [6]
- **gd1973-09-11.116231.aud.warburton.berger.cousinit-patched.flac16**: transferred by Rob Berger;Cousinit;Jimmy Warburton; source: Original source: AUD Jimmy Warburton's reel; [2]
